description: Connect a platform WhatsApp number to one of the account's agents, so the owner can message that number and reach that agent. Requires the owner to be verified first. Take phone_number_id from get_agent_whatsapp. A number already used by another account is still valid to connect: it answers only this owner's verified phone.

agent_id.description: The agent that should answer on this number.

name: attach_agent_whatsapp
title: Attach Agent Whatsapp
